title: Crash-Proof Quiz Persistence & Bento UI Modernization (v0.4.7)
message: Persistent crash-proof quiz sessions, modern Bento question cards, and unified glassmorphic UI across all student and challenge screens.
changelog:
• Crash-Proof Quiz Persistence: Quiz progress is continuously auto-saved to SharedPreferences. Exiting the app or experiencing a crash allows seamless resumption right where you left off without wasting attempts or AI generations.
• Premium Bento Question Card: Redesigned the quiz question view into a modern Bento card with 0dp elevation, crisp 1.5dp borders, 24dp squircle corners, question type pill badges, and context clue guidance.
• Unified Glassmorphic Headers: Standardized sticky FastBlurView headers with real-time backdrop blur, insets support, and borderless navigation across Leaderboard, Daily Quests, Quest Details, Initiation, Quiz History, Progress Dashboard, and Achievements.
• Bento Card Overhauls: Replaced cheap 1dp material card elevations in Achievements, Daily Quests, and Progress Dashboard with modern Bento squircle cards, squircle icon frames, and tactile spring feedback.
